title: Maximum Sum of Distinct Subarrays With Length K
goal: Find the maximum sum of a length-k subarray with all distinct values.
strategy: Maintain the fixed window sum and a frequency map. Once the window reaches length k, it is eligible exactly when the map also contains k distinct keys.
